usedFor: tawk.to holds chats, and Documint fills a template when “New Chat Transcript Arrives” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Chat Transcript Arrives” in tawk.to, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A saved transcript goes into a Documint template, so each chat gets a document of its own.

watchOut: “Add Content To Template” fills a template you already built in Documint, so set one up first.
